bounded_resolution.design: paired initial draft and audits; cached initial wall time deducted from remaining budget; fresh post-revision audits

guideline_gating: Each guideline is evaluated against its complete source-only index. No pooled headline metrics.
references: Engineering-authored before inference; not clinician adjudicated.
review_status: All sources technically checked; gold relevance and clinical applicability pending clinician review.
historical_runtime_drift: Historical verifier SHA differs; original 18 are rerun using current frozen verifier. Historical numbers are not a bit-identical runtime comparison.
transport: Provider failures excluded from quality and logged separately; semantic failures retained; checkpoint every completed role.
faults: 12 faults per guideline, 36 total; original four fault families and three variants
scope_amendment: User requested exactly 100 cases and inclusion of WHO before any generation. Earlier retrieval-only 114-case prototype is retained separately. No retrieval hyperparameters changed.
index_amendment: Removed exact duplicate WHO text blocks using source text SHA only. Case text, gold IDs, retrieval algorithms, RRF60 and top4 unchanged. Pre-generation structural correction, not score-based tuning.
operational_amendment: Restore the original three bounded retries for minute-rate/server errors; stop immediately on daily quota. Preserve every completed role and all semantic outcomes. No model/prompt/retrieval change.
backbone_call_pacing: Original 20-second minimum cloud-call gap is shared across cases and models; no backbone inference preceded this pacing correction.
statistics_implementation_notes: Added original-18 control and explicit partial-score snapshots; unchanged metric/model/seed/bootstrap configurations. Partial snapshots cannot update the manuscript.
historical_transport_deviation: Current frozen verifier passes a 1000-token auditor completion limit. The historical evaluator wrapper omitted completion kwargs and therefore used the transport default. Historical and current results must not be claimed to use identical verifier/transport code.
quality_classification_correction: Plain ValueError in complete_json denotes decoded non-object model content, not provider unavailability. Retain this completed malformed reply as a quality outcome; do not resample it.
completed_error_checkpoint_recovery: Hydrate missing older role-cache entries from saved completed responses/error classes; never resample malformed non-object replies.
judge_error_policy: Completed malformed or truncated judge replies are unavailable ratings and retained without resampling. Only provider errors stop for later transport resume.
decoder_rejection_policy: Provider json_validate_failed is a completed model contract failure even when carried in HTTP 400. Preserve it and do not resample. Genuine HTTP configuration errors remain provider failures.
completion_status: All 100 primary cases, 36 faults, 100 judge stages and 200 backbone pairs completed.
